note: Boulevard des Départs place 1/5; landmark: tall green iron column with a big round station clock in the middle of the poplar boulevard. First place: the poplar boulevard leaves the S08 square (the poplar avenue between the globe-sign house and the station). Clock column in the middle: -er scenes left of it; aller (irregular), sortir and partir on the right. Repainted once so the hikers (aller) are on the right and the balcony man stands behind the railing; cooled k 0.5; shrunk 0.9. No -er/-ir markers, no painted text.
